31266.a:
```sh
pwd; cd -; cd ~
ls -lah --sort=time
mkdir -p a/b/c
cp -a src/ dst/        # ruxsat, vaqt, symlink saqlanadi
mv old new
rm -ri dir             # interaktiv
ln -s /opt/app/v2 /opt/app/current
less +F app.log        # tail -f kabi, to'xtatib qidirish mumkin
tail -n 100 -f app.log
stat file; file blob
```
`cp -a` va `cp -r` farqi: `-a` = `-dR --preserve=all`.

31267.a:
```sh
grep -rin "error" /var/log/app/     # rekursiv, case-insensitive, qator raqami
grep -v DEBUG app.log                # teskari
grep -E "5[0-9]{2}" access.log
cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd              # user nomlari
sort -t, -k3 -n data.csv             # 3-ustun, son bo'yicha
sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
wc -l file
tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'; tr -d '\r'           # Windows CRLF
```
`uniq` faqat **qo'shni** takrorlarni ko'radi — shuning uchun avval `sort`.

31268.a:
```sh
sed -i.bak 's/old/new/g' app.conf        # in-place + backup
sed -n '10,20p' file                     # 10-20 qatorlar
sed '/^#/d; /^$/d' nginx.conf            # izoh/bo'sh qator o'chirish

awk '{print $1}' access.log              # 1-ustun
awk '$9 >= 500 {c++} END {print c}' access.log
awk -F, '{s+=$3} END {print s/NR}' data.csv   # o'rtacha
awk '{a[$1]+=$10} END {for (k in a) print k, a[k]}' access.log
```
Qoida: almashtirish — sed; ustun/hisob — awk; murakkab parse (JSON) — `jq`.

31269.a:
```sh
curl -s api/users | jq '.[] | select(.active) | .email'
kubectl get pods -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.phase!="Running") | .metadata.name'
aws ec2 describe-instances | jq -r '.Reservations[].Instances[] | [.InstanceId,.State.Name] | @tsv'
jq -n --arg v "$VER" '{version:$v}'   # xavfsiz JSON yaratish
```
`-r` — raw string (qo'shtirnoqsiz). JSON'ni `grep`/`sed` bilan parse qilish — mo'rt, qilma. YAML uchun — `yq`.

31270.a:
```sh
./deploy.sh 2>&1 | tee deploy.log
echo "x" | sudo tee /etc/conf >/dev/null   # sudo + redirect muammosi yechimi
diff -u old.conf new.conf
comm -13 <(sort a) <(sort b)               # faqat b'da borlar
watch -n 2 'kubectl get pods'
timeout 30s curl -s http://svc/health || echo "timeout"
```
`sudo echo x > /etc/f` ishlamaydi — redirect sudo'siz shell'da bajariladi; shuning uchun `sudo tee`.

31271.a:
| Amal | Buyruq |
|---|---|
| Insert rejim | `i`, `a`, `o` |
| Normal'ga qaytish | `Esc` |
| Saqlash / chiqish | `:w`, `:q`, `:wq`, `:q!` |
| Qidirish | `/err`, `n`/`N` |
| Almashtirish | `:%s/old/new/g` |
| Qator o'chirish / nusxa / qo'yish | `dd`, `yy`, `p` |
| Undo / redo | `u`, `Ctrl+r` |
| Qatorga o'tish | `:120`, `G`, `gg` |
| Qator raqami | `:set nu` |

Nega bilish shart: minimal server/konteynerda ko'pincha faqat `vi` bor.

31272.a:
- **nano:** o'rganish shart emas, `Ctrl+W` qidirish, `Ctrl+K` qator kesish. Ko'p distroda default.
- **vim/vi:** minimal image va rescue rejimda ham bor; makro, regex almashtirish, split.
- **emacs** — serverda kam.

Default editor: `EDITOR`/`VISUAL` env (`crontab -e`, `git commit`, `visudo`, `kubectl edit` shuni ishlatadi).
```sh
export EDITOR=vim
sudo update-alternatives --config editor
```

nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx
